study: PaperII frozen-backbone head-only representation transfer; independent of PaperI kernels
compatible_base: Qwen3.5-4B-Base; same full content hashes and rank8 QLoRA shapes

task_interpretations.GMS: BC cross-survey; BS in-domain control, clean held-out galaxies
task_interpretations.C_SPEC: BS cross-survey; BC in-domain control; exploratory new split of previously inspected Stage3 T2
task_interpretations.C_ZPHOT: BS cross-survey ZPHOT agreement; BC in-domain control, not true-redshift accuracy

controls.smooth_sigma3: Fixed Gaussian neighbor-label sigma3 bins atK64/256, all tasks/backbones
controls.mean_pooling: Canonical masked mean atK64/256, all tasks/backbones
controls.formatting: Same alternate flat signed-flux/error strings atK64/256 forGMS andC_SPEC, all backbones; source-native-like structural control, not exact BC median-imputed magnitude native format
controls.negative_adapter: Optional zero-effect initialized LoRA insertion check on B0, no backbone randomization required

feature_normalization: Fit each feature mean and populationSTD on K support objects only; STD floor5% of median positiveSTD, absolute floor1e-4; clip standardized coordinates to[-10,10]; same rule for all backbones; no transductive/query statistics

head.initialization: Fresh torch seed; identical initial weights across same-dimension backbone heads; never initialize from old head

optim.selection: Minimum development hard CE, including initialization; same head and subset seeds, batch indices and budget for all backbones

grid.outside: Count and exclude, never clip labels

point_estimator: CDF median on original300 bin centers
sparse_supervision: Main hard CE retained at allK. Separate fixed sigma3 smoothing at primaryK; no query choice of loss/smoothing.
pilot: K64/256, subset101, head11, canonical/last/hard andsmooth, alltasks/allbackbones. No query metrics during pilot. ModerateK256 source/development learning must pass. Full protocol locked before any query evaluation.
learning_gate: At least2/3 backbones per task improve development hardCE by>=0.05 with positive selected update atK256 under at least one preregistered loss; each selected head finite, training loss decreases>=0.3, frozen feature checks pass. Nonlearning arms are reported without interpreting them as representation rankings.
numerical_controls: Uncertainty-aware target photometric kNN KDE, fixed k=min(10,K), Gaussian redshift bandwidthmax(.03*(1+zi),support_z_STD/sqrtK)
Compact target-only numerical MLP, same hidden32/output300/optimizer/head seeds/batches and hard loss; sigma3 control at primaryK
Affine correction of original frozen source-head median, ridge toward slope1, Gaussian residual PDF with fixed .03 minimum width; same K support; GMS usesBC, CLAUDS usesBS
uncertainty: Paired galaxy bootstrap1000 replicates(seed1029) conditional on subset/head seed; separate variability across3 subset seeds and2 initialization seeds; no pooling repeated predictions as independent galaxies
query_policy: All head/checkpoint/normalizer selections completed and hashed before sealed query labels are read. T2 reuse explicitly exploratory. No query-driven pooling, format, optimization orK selection.
exposure_diagnostic: Evaluate primaryK64/256 frozen heads also on separately tagged historically trained objects; non-independent descriptive diagnostic, not matched causal exposure effect
original_heads: Separate frozen original-head references on shared strings; never initialize fresh heads. BC native grid differs from fresh grid, so native-grid CE is not directly compared or plotted as K0 on fresh learning curve.

extraction.quantization: NF4 double quantization, BF16 compute, same kbit preparation forB0/BS/BC
extraction.model_mode: eval, allrequires_gradFalse, inference_mode, no KV cache
extraction.mean_control: FP32 masked mean from same forward
extraction.integrity: Native archived-head replay where executable, exact adapter tensor reload, parameter version counters and sample digests, unchanged on-disk hashes
extraction.cache: Once per object per backbone/serialization; both pooling vectors saved; IDs and allinput/model/code hashes bound
